recaps.title: Politics & Washington
recaps.intro: Hegseth survived an impeachment push by a handful of votes while the White House warned Democrats off aggressive oversight, and two Senate races are still being counted.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: House narrowly sidelines the effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on a 211-204 vote
bullets.note: It temporarily eases the political pressure on Trump and his Pentagon chief.

bullets.text: Traffic gridlock kept some Democrats from making the Hegseth vote, Fox's Chad Pergram reports
bullets.note: He reports the House may otherwise have impeached Hegseth, showing how thin the margin was.

bullets.text: White House warns congressional Democrats that aggressive oversight of the administration could be a crime
bullets.note: Experts called the threat legally dubious as Democrats prepare investigations in the new Congress.

bullets.text: Trump honors soldiers who died in the war in Iran in a Veterans Day speech at Arlington National Cemetery
bullets.note: The president marked the holiday with a wreath-laying at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

bullets.text: Mississippi Senate race leans Democratic with 98 percent counted, while Alaska stays a toss-up, CBS News projects
bullets.note: Two Senate races are still unresolved more than a week after the midterms.

bullets.text: Axios: Inside Bessent's Situation Room confrontation with Lutnick over China chip security
bullets.note: It shows a split inside the Cabinet over chip security as the Nvidia spy case grows.

bullets.text: Rubio's personal travel has cost the government more than $1.2 million, a Washington Post review finds
bullets.note: Former State Department officials say his travel appears to far outpace his predecessors'.

bullets.text: More Hill Republicans are looking at Marco Rubio for 2028
bullets.note: The post-Trump race for the Republican nomination is already taking shape.

bullets.text: Democratic Socialists of America win eight House seats, with at least 54 DSA-backed state lawmakers in 19 states
bullets.note: The movement's growth will be felt in Congress and statehouses come January.

bullets.text: Reuters: How a Vitol trader's ties to JD Vance helped land a prized Venezuela oil contract
bullets.note: The exclusive traces how ties to the vice president figured in a prized Venezuela oil contract.

bullets.text: Biden says he would not have run in 2024 if he had known about his cancer
bullets.note: The former president is looking back on his decision to seek a second term before he dropped out.

recaps.title: World
recaps.intro: Russia's ambassador to Washington died as the Abu Dhabi talks ended with a prisoner swap but no breakthrough, and Iran dug in on its enriched uranium.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Russia's ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, dies at 66, the Russian Foreign Ministry says
bullets.note: Moscow loses its top envoy in Washington in the middle of U.S.-brokered peace diplomacy.

bullets.text: Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi end without a breakthrough despite a deal on a major prisoner exchange
bullets.note: The prisoner swap is the main concrete result of the first three-way talks in months.

bullets.text: Iran will not allow enriched nuclear material to leave the country, its security chief says
bullets.note: Trump has cited Iran's nuclear program as the core reason for the war, so this hardens the standoff.

bullets.text: U.S. accuses three Iran-backed operatives of plotting nearly 20 attacks on Jewish communities in Europe and the U.S.
bullets.note: The alleged plot also included an assault on a British air base used by the U.S. Air Force.

bullets.text: Saudi air defenses intercept three Houthi cruise missiles launched toward Riyadh
bullets.note: Attacks on the Saudi capital add to regional risk alongside the Iran war.

bullets.text: Indonesia's vice president Gibran Rakabuming Raka has resigned, sources tell Reuters
bullets.note: It came after more than 100 lawmakers signed a petition demanding his impeachment.

bullets.text: At least four people, including small children, are killed when heavy rain collapses a sandbank in Gaza
bullets.note: Hundreds of thousands of Palestinians face a fourth winter in tents.

bullets.text: Portugal cancels more than 200 flights and shuts schools as Storm Charles hits
bullets.note: The storm is disrupting travel and daily life across the country.

bullets.text: U.S. warns South Sudan's leaders are raising the risk of renewed civil war and obstructing UN peacekeepers
bullets.note: Washington says their conduct will shape future aid and diplomatic engagement.

bullets.text: Romania's intelligence agency says it identified a Russian-linked cyberattack
bullets.note: Another European government is pointing to Russia over a cyberattack.

bullets.text: Taiwan names the Acer founder as its APEC envoy and calls for written guarantees from China
bullets.note: Taipei wants written guarantees from Beijing as it names its APEC representative.

bullets.text: Pope Leo draws 2 million people at his final Argentina event before heading home to Peru
bullets.note: The Latin America tour keeps drawing enormous crowds.

recaps.title: Market open
recaps.intro: Stocks opened higher, led by tech and chips, after CoreWeave's beat and raised forecast revived the AI trade a day after a hot October CPI report. The bond market is closed for Veterans Day.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Stocks open higher: Nasdaq up 1.5%, S&P 500 up 0.95%, Dow up 0.2%
bullets.note: After the open the Nasdaq stood at 25,448.77, the S&P 500 at 7,592.62 and the Dow at 52,328.81.

bullets.text: US stock futures extended gains overnight as CoreWeave results offset bets on higher rates
bullets.note: Nasdaq 100 futures were up as much as 2% before the bell, and S&P 500 futures up 1%, a day after the hot CPI report.

bullets.text: CoreWeave beats on revenue and raises its 2026 forecast
bullets.note: Q3 revenue was $3.66 billion vs $3.55 billion expected, up 168%; 2026 revenue now seen at $13 billion to $13.3 billion. Shares rose 13% premarket.

bullets.text: Chip stocks rally after CoreWeave results ease AI fears
bullets.note: Marvell up 8.5%, Micron 6.6%, Intel 6.3%, Broadcom 6.2% and the SOXX chip fund 4.8%.

bullets.text: Premarket movers: Nvidia up 5% after two losing days; NextNav up 9%; Talen Energy up nearly 5%
bullets.note: Nvidia was down nearly 10% this week after CEO Jensen Huang confirmed an affair with an alleged Chinese spy; NextNav's loss narrowed; Talen signed a 7-year power deal.

bullets.text: House China panel chair gives Nvidia CEO until end of business today, says subpoenas likely
bullets.note: Rep. John Moolenaar's deadline, reported by Fox Business, keeps Washington pressure on Nvidia during the session.

bullets.text: Bond market closed for Veterans Day while stock exchanges trade a full session
bullets.note: SIFMA's 2026 schedule lists Wednesday, Nov. 11 as a full close for US bond trading, so there is no Treasury session today.

bullets.text: Anthropic IPO said to be multiple times oversubscribed
bullets.note: Per Bloomberg, investor orders far exceed shares on offer; the Claude maker aims to raise up to $90.4 billion ahead of its Nasdaq debut.

bullets.text: Saudi oil output jumped 26% in October to 10.56 million barrels a day, OPEC says
bullets.note: OPEC's monthly report also left its 2026 and 2027 oil demand growth forecasts unchanged.

bullets.text: Mortgage applications rose 6.2% last week as the 30-year rate eased to 7.21%
bullets.note: MBA data, the main US release on a holiday-light calendar; the prior week fell 1.2% and the rate was 7.30%.

bullets.text: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee calls October inflation data borderline disturbing
bullets.note: He spoke to PBS on Tuesday after CPI rose 0.4% in October, adding to Fed rate hike worries.

recaps.title: Morning briefing
recaps.intro: Russia and Ukraine agreed on a big prisoner release as the Abu Dhabi talks ended, while the House shelved Hegseth's impeachment and Republicans picked new leaders.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Russia and Ukraine agree to a large release of prisoners of war, officials at the Abu Dhabi talks say
bullets.note: The agreement came out of the U.S.-Ukraine-Russia peace talks in Abu Dhabi

bullets.text: Jared Kushner calls the Abu Dhabi talks a positive step and says the U.S. delegation will meet Putin in Moscow on Thursday
bullets.note: He spoke at a press conference after the talks ended Wednesday

bullets.text: House blocks the effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, largely over the war with Iran
bullets.note: Rep. Thomas Massie, who introduced the articles, was the lone Republican to vote with all Democrats

bullets.text: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moves to a military base after an Iranian threat against his life, the New York Times reports
bullets.note: Reuters also reported the move, both citing people familiar with the matter

bullets.text: Republicans pick John Thune and Jim Jordan to lead them against the incoming Democratic-controlled Congress
bullets.note: Democrats take power in January for the final two years of Trump's presidency

bullets.text: Judge lets Trump's $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC go forward but throws out his unfair trade practices claim
bullets.note: The suit is over a misleadingly edited clip of a Trump speech

bullets.text: Kennedy family members ask a judge to block Trump's planned memorial arch near Arlington National Cemetery
bullets.note: They say the structure would cast a shadow over their relatives' gravesites

bullets.text: US lenders do not plan to approve a Kazakh mine deal backed by Trump's sons, a US official says
bullets.note: A setback for a deal tied to the president's family

bullets.text: At least three people are dead after a vehicle struck pedestrians in North Hollywood, officials say
bullets.note: A deadly crash in Los Angeles overnight

bullets.text: At least 300 schools in Italy are evacuated after receiving the same bomb alert message
bullets.note: Italy's education minister gave the figure

bullets.text: Workers in Spain stage a general strike over the country's housing affordability crisis
bullets.note: It comes a few weeks before a snap general election

bullets.text: Iran designates Argentina's navy and air force as terrorist organizations
bullets.note: Iran adds the two branches of Argentina's armed forces to its terrorist list

bullets.text: Kenya discharges its last Ebola patient, starting the 42-day countdown to being declared Ebola-free
bullets.note: Cases in the wider region have topped 11,000 since the outbreak began in May

bullets.text: Cold air from Canada could help spawn a nor'easter along the East Coast Thursday into Friday
bullets.note: It ends an unseasonably warm start to November across the East

bullets.text: Stacy Keach, the stage actor who became a TV star as detective Mike Hammer, dies at 85
bullets.note: He was known for playing tough guys on screen

recaps.title: AI & tech
recaps.intro: Anthropic's trillion-dollar IPO and OpenAI's rising revenue and losses lead tech, as the Nvidia spy affair keeps widening in Washington.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Anthropic's IPO will value the Claude maker at up to $1.4 trillion, slightly short of some investors' expectations
bullets.note: A key test of Wall Street's faith in the AI boom

bullets.text: Anthropic seeks $3 billion to $3.5 billion from Japanese investors as part of its IPO
bullets.note: Shows the global reach of the offering

bullets.text: Anthropic releases a suite of tools that bring its AI into everyday office work
bullets.note: Puts it in sharper competition with its backers Microsoft and Google

bullets.text: OpenAI grew revenue about 50% to $10 billion from the second to the third quarter but kept posting heavy operating losses, the WSJ reports
bullets.note: Mixed results as it tries to catch up with Anthropic

bullets.text: A PLA-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips last month despite being on a US export blacklist, records show
bullets.note: Highlights gaps in Washington's efforts to curb China's access to advanced chips

bullets.text: Sen. Kevin Cramer calls on Jensen Huang to step down as Nvidia CEO over his affair with an alleged Chinese spy
bullets.note: Cramer sits on the Senate Banking Committee

bullets.text: Nvidia shed about $430 billion in market value over two sessions as questions about Huang deepened
bullets.note: The reports concern Huang's relationship with a businesswoman alleged to be a spy for Beijing

bullets.text: Nvidia shares rebound 4% as Huang faces scrutiny ahead of earnings
bullets.note: A bounce after the steep two-day drop

bullets.text: US Ambassador David Perdue says the Huang affair furor is a test for US-China relations
bullets.note: Comes as the leaders of the two nations prepare to meet

bullets.text: CoreWeave stock jumps 16% after the company raises its outlook
bullets.note: The raise eased concerns about an AI slowdown

bullets.text: Microsoft and others press the Trump administration to halt a planned ban on a Chinese component used in AI data centers
bullets.note: A Reuters exclusive on a fight over data center supply chains

bullets.text: Alibaba plans to list T-Head, its Nvidia chip rival
bullets.note: China keeps building its own AI chip champions

bullets.text: Google DeepMind says AI has for the first time mathematically proven Signal's protocol secure down to the code level
bullets.note: It used its AlphaProof Code framework on the messaging app's cryptography

bullets.text: Bessent says the US and China should harbor no illusions as they cooperate and compete on AI
bullets.note: He expects further dialogue on AI models ahead of Trump's visit to China

recaps.title: Sports
recaps.intro: Paul George powered the Celtics to the top of the East and the NFL trade deadline sent Kirk Cousins back to Minnesota.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Paul George scores 36 in his return to Philadelphia as the Celtics win a fourth straight and move to No. 1 in the East
bullets.note: Jayson Tatum added 21 and Payton Pritchard 18

bullets.text: Karl-Anthony Towns becomes the third Knick to open a season with 10 straight double-doubles as New York wins a fourth straight
bullets.note: He joins Walt Bellamy and Willis Reed; he had 21 points and 16 rebounds

bullets.text: Damian Lillard scores 13 of his 25 in the third quarter as the Blazers move to 7-3
bullets.note: He hit a logo three to beat the third-quarter buzzer

bullets.text: Giannis Antetokounmpo's double-double leads the Heat to a win in Salt Lake City
bullets.note: Darryn Peterson scored 25 in the game

bullets.text: Raiders trade QB Kirk Cousins to the Vikings for a 2027 third-round pick
bullets.note: Deal struck before Tuesday's trade deadline, per ESPN

bullets.text: No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza takes over as the Raiders' starting quarterback
bullets.note: Las Vegas is 4-5 and his first two starts come against the Seahawks and Broncos

bullets.text: Colts deal Quenton Nelson, DeForest Buckner, Josh Downs and Keenan Allen before the deadline
bullets.note: The return is 2027 and 2028 picks from Seattle, San Francisco and Kansas City

bullets.text: Nine first- or second-round picks were traded this season, the most since at least 1990
bullets.note: A busy deadline across the league

bullets.text: Vikings release WR Odell Beckham Jr.
bullets.note: Per ESPN

bullets.text: Kyle McCord becomes the Dolphins' starting quarterback
bullets.note: Miami acquired him last summer from the Packers

bullets.text: Cardinals put QB Gardner Minshew II and WR Michael Wilson on injured reserve; neither is expected back this season
bullets.note: A blow to Arizona's offense

bullets.text: Kirill Kaprizov scores in overtime to win it for the Wild
bullets.note: An overtime win for Minnesota

bullets.text: NHL and NHLPA will discuss smoothing the salary cap over the next two seasons
bullets.note: Per Sportsnet's Elliotte Friedman

bullets.text: Linda Noskova beats Coco Gauff 6-3, 6-3 to become the first player into the WTA Finals semifinals
bullets.note: Pegula and Gauff are still alive for the group's second spot

bullets.text: Utah reaches its highest College Football Playoff ranking in school history
bullets.note: Alabama climbs to No. 3, Notre Dame jumps to No. 5 and Miami drops to No. 7 after losing to Notre Dame

recaps.title: Vermont on X
recaps.intro: Snow is on the way for Thursday night and Friday, the Notch road is closed, and the state certified a record midterm turnout.
recaps.label: From posts on X

bullets.text: Heaviest snow expected Thursday evening into Friday, with hazardous travel possible on both commutes
bullets.note: Isolated power outages are possible above 1,200 feet, and winter weather headlines may be needed

bullets.text: VT-108 between Cambridge and Stowe closed from 6 p.m. Tuesday ahead of the weather
bullets.note: Crews will decide whether the Notch can reopen

bullets.text: I-89 northbound Exit 9 on-ramp in Middlesex closed today from 9 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. for tree cutting
bullets.note: Plan an alternate route

bullets.text: Homelessness ticked up in Chittenden County this year, with a troubling rise in homeless children across Vermont
bullets.note: From the annual point-in-time count

bullets.text: Vermont sets a midterm turnout record as election results are certified
bullets.note: Official results are now final

bullets.text: Vermont wildlife officials warn hunters after chronic wasting disease is found in New York
bullets.note: The deer disease is now next door during hunting season

bullets.text: Crews work to recover a missing boater's body from Lake Champlain
bullets.note: The search had gone on for days

bullets.text: Sentencing date set for the Burlington man found guilty of shooting Palestinian American students
bullets.note: The next step in the Burlington shooting case

bullets.text: Lawmakers seek answers on Lake Champlain cleanup as an audit stalls
bullets.note: Questions over progress on the lake's cleanup

bullets.text: Lake Champlain sturgeon study offers hope for the endangered species
bullets.note: A hopeful sign for the endangered fish in the lake
